links.comparator_used: No comparator; compared OCSVM inlier counts across three simulated noise levels (5%, 10%, 30%) against the training-data reference distribution
links.outcome: Number of simulated drifted records classed as inliers by a one-class SVM trained on the reference (Wisconsin Breast Cancer) data, used as a label-free population drift signal
links.effect: As noise increased, more inliers were detected: 5% (27 inliers), 10% (486), 30% (851), from 10,000 simulated records per noise level
links.quote: As noise increased, more inliers were detected: 5% (27 inliers), 10% (486), and 30% (851).
